versions.changelog:
- 新增动态横幅表情功能，包括星光边框横幅、状态表情、红底金框横幅等定制项
- 更新描述及使用示例，明确支持动态横幅、定制状态表情等新场景
- 「能做什么」部分详细区分免费功能与定制项，新增横幅及状态表情相关说明
- 示例表情包链接替换为支持动态横幅的新版演示包
- 增强动效模版选择说明，发光文字表情支持两种模板
- 文档表述更加全面，涵盖更多用户需求场景

- Initial release of tg-sticker-studio.
- Enables creation and management of Telegram sticker packs via @KKkelong_bot.
- Supports building new sticker packs, cloning/merging/deduplicating packs, creating glowing animated text emoji, and custom animated icons.
- Free features include pack creation, cloning, deduplication, and text emoji (with limited free redos).
- Premium options for more customization and private commissions available.
